questions.title: Function Definition Components
questions.description: Which of the following correctly describes a function definition in C?
questions.Option1: It consists of a return type, function name, parameter list, and a body containing statements
questions.Option2: It only declares the function name and return type without a body
questions.Option3: It must always be placed before main in the source file
questions.Option4: It cannot contain a return statement

questions.title: void Return Type Meaning
questions.description: What does a return type of void indicate for a function in C?
questions.Option1: The function does not return a value
questions.Option3: The function can return any type

questions.title: Function Declaration Purpose
questions.description: What is the primary purpose of a function prototype in C?
questions.Option1: To declare the function's signature before its definition so it can be called earlier in the file
questions.Option2: To define the function body in advance
questions.Option3: To allocate memory for the function's local variables
questions.Option4: To force the function to be inlined by the compiler

questions.title: Call by Value Semantics
questions.description: In C, when an argument is passed to a function by value, what happens?
questions.Option1: A copy of the argument's value is made; changes inside the function do not affect the original variable
questions.Option2: The function receives the memory address of the argument
questions.Option3: The function can modify the original variable directly
questions.Option4: The argument is shared between caller and function

questions.title: Function Parameter Declaration
questions.description: Which of the following correctly declares a function that takes two int parameters and returns int?
questions.Option4: function int add(int a, int b);

questions.title: Return Statement Behavior
questions.description: What happens when a return statement is encountered during a function's execution?
questions.Option1: The function immediately exits and returns the specified value to the caller
questions.Option2: The function pauses execution and resumes later
questions.Option3: The function restarts from the beginning
questions.Option4: The function continues to the next statement

questions.title: main Return Type Convention
questions.description: What is the conventional return type of main in a hosted C program, and what does returning 0 signify?
questions.Option1: int; returning 0 indicates successful execution to the operating system

questions.title: Function Signature Components
questions.description: Which of the following is part of a function's signature in C?
questions.Option1: The function name and the parameter types

questions.title: void Parameter List Meaning
questions.description: What does 'int func(void)' indicate?
questions.Option2: The function takes any number of parameters
questions.Option4: The function returns a void pointer

questions.title: Modular Design Benefit
questions.description: Which of the following is a key benefit of modular design using functions?
questions.Option1: Code is split into reusable, testable units that hide implementation details
questions.Option2: Programs run faster automatically without any other change
